title: Experimental Features
summary: This module houses experimental features, including conversational AI capabilities and evaluation tools for agents and crews. These features are subject to change as they evolve.

nodes.label: Conversational Mixin
nodes.title: Conversational AI Capabilities
nodes.description: Provides experimental conversational AI features for Flows, enabling chat behavior, routing, and message handling within a conversational context.

nodes.label: Conversation Start Router
nodes.title: Route Conversational Turns
nodes.description: A decorator that marks a method as the starting point and router for conversational turns, integrating it into the Flow's execution graph.

nodes.label: Base Evaluator
nodes.title: Abstract Base for Evaluation
nodes.description: An abstract base class for creating evaluators, defining the interface for assessing agent and crew performance based on specific metrics.

nodes.label: Run Experiment
nodes.title: Execute Evaluation Experiments
nodes.description: Executes an evaluation experiment on a given dataset with a specified crew or agents, returning the results for analysis.

nodes.label: Assert Experiment Success
nodes.title: Validate Experiment Results
nodes.description: Asserts that an experiment ran successfully and optionally compares its results against a baseline to detect regressions.

groups.label: Conversational AI
groups.title: Conversational AI Features
groups.description: Components enabling interactive chat and conversational flow management within the system.

groups.label: Evaluation Tools
groups.title: Agent and Crew Evaluation
groups.description: Tools and frameworks for evaluating the performance and correctness of agents and crews through experiments and assertions.
